code_changes.reason: POST-HOC addendum 3 in code, before any post-discovery runner starts. Item 1 (freezing eligibility, section 15): discovery.freezing_eligibility + FREEZING_RULE replace the flag passed_items_1_5_v5_primary with eligible_for_freezing (every R19 item R19 EVALUATES in discovery is PASS and no item is FAIL; item 4 NOT_EVALUATED by addendum 1 item 3 does not disqualify), and the literal section 3.1 V5-P trigger is reported separately as section_3_1_v5p_trigger (V5P_TRIGGER_RULE); the V5-P not_run marker says so. Item 2 (deployed configuration, section 11 / F6): h3.deployed_configuration returns the ladder's RETAINED configuration and now includes its base step M0 (= B5) when neither M1 nor M2 is kept (h3.LADDER_BASE), with addendum 2's remaining order (M2 / B6 by the stop-rule scope, then B3i) reached only when the ladder retains no step at all; READINGS['deployed_rule'] states it and no longer asks for a further addendum; h3.py and g19_run_h3.py docstrings follow. Item 3: g19_run_ladder tests the M0-retained not_run case BEFORE the 40 h budget check, so M3-M7 are not_run for the registered reason independently of any ledger demotion and no ladder wall clock is consumed. registry.verify_record now also accepts a SUPERSEDED entry of the record's own stage (registry.superseded_entries) and register_stage_from_tree / the CLI take --force, so re-registering the post-discovery stages under the three-addenda text validates or invalidates no record written earlier (addendum 2 item 5). Nothing re-validates or invalidates a discovery record: no CODE_FILES file and no RUNNER_OBJECTS function was touched, so the live discovery code digest is unchanged (d4ddf83c...) and the 'discovery' (895a6ab9...) and 'discovery_candidates' entries are untouched. Tests: test_h3, test_discovery_runner, test_registry.

code_changes.reason: TASK P, fixes 2 and 3 to the never-executed section 8 power runner. (2) g19_run_power.run_contrast now annotates every injected prediction frame with wildcard_copy_partner_in_training via g19_score_discovery.wildcard_flags on the frame's own design stem, as the scorer's Store.frame does; without it D.filtered_pair raised KeyError on the registered wildcard-copy scoring filter, so no contrast could be scored.
